comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C1, C7, C8, C47, C48, C49 regarding basic behavioral findings of differential feeding on familiar vs novel bacteria. Both evaluations find these claims SUPPORTED, with reviewers describing the work as 'thorough, interesting, and novel' and OpenEval noting appropriate experimental controls.

Disagreement on claims C2, C26, C35 regarding ADF calcium imaging and ablation. OpenEval finds claims SUPPORTED with strong convergent evidence, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about lack of second comparison, missing technical details (baseline ratios, bleaching rates), and questions about whether ADF activation directly elicits pumping.

Agreement on claims C3, C27 regarding serotonin release from ADF. Both find these SUPPORTED. However, peer review does not explicitly address C35 which OpenEval includes, suggesting partial overlap in scope.

Disagreement on claims C18, C19, C20, C21 regarding ADF vs NSM specificity. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED based on genetic rescue and ablation data, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to day-to-day variability concerns affecting interpretation of negative conclusions in ablation experiments.

Disagreement on serotonin receptor claims C10-C16. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED based on pharmacological and genetic data, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to serious concerns about day-to-day variations being as large or larger than familiarity effects, particularly questioning negative conclusions when control pumping rates are very low.

Agreement on claims C22-C25, C67-C69, C71 regarding MC neuron involvement and genetic rescue experiments. Both find these SUPPORTED, though peer review also includes C4, C5, C34, C75 in their evaluation. General variability concerns apply but do not override acceptance of the mechanistic pathway.

Partial overlap on claims C4, C5, C34, C69 regarding serotonin signaling to MC neurons. Both find these SUPPORTED. OpenEval focuses on the endocrine signaling pathway while peer review groups these with broader mechanistic claims about the ADF-serotonin-SER-7-MC pathway.

Agreement on claims C6, C28, C36, C37, C38 regarding conditioned media experiments and antagonistic regulation model. Both find these SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers describing the work as thorough and novel without specific challenges to this mechanistic interpretation.

Agreement on claims C62, C63 regarding robustness across genetic backgrounds and sexes. Both find these SUPPORTED, with peer reviewers noting consistency of behavioral results as mitigating concerns about incomplete testing.

Disagreement on claims C58-C61 regarding statistical comparisons between bacterial strains. OpenEval finds these straightforward SUPPORTED observations, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about day-to-day variations and whether data from different days can be appropriately grouped together.

Disagreement on claims C76, C77 regarding receptor-specific contributions in double mutants. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED based on statistical analysis, while peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about magnitude of effects relative to day-to-day variability.

OpenEval evaluates claims C72-C75 regarding eat-2; ser-7 double mutants as SUPPORTED, noting C74 is an inference and biological significance is unclear. No corresponding peer review evaluation found, though C75 appears in peer R6 grouped with other claims.
OpenEval evaluates claims C78, C79 regarding SER-7 constitutive activity as SUPPORTED but explicitly speculative. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates claims C80-C83 regarding immunohistochemistry controls as SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates claims C85-C89 regarding calcium imaging apparatus as SUPPORTED methodological description. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates claim C39 as UNCERTAIN due to being preliminary unpublished data without figures or statistical analysis. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates claims C50, C55, C57 as UNCERTAIN, noting they are explicitly speculative statements about evolutionary function. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.

OpenEval evaluates claims C29-C33, C40-C46, C51-C52, C56, C64-C66, C84 as SUPPORTED, noting these represent established knowledge from prior literature providing context. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates claims C53, C54 as SUPPORTED logical inferences based on established knowledge and current findings. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
